data.body: Final RCA/prevention: Gerrit missing-object recurrences were caused by ad-hoc host-side native-git repair/maintenance run as root in the live Gerrit bare repo. Evidence: live JGit receive.autogc=false and no GC/prune logs; disk and kernel I/O checks clean; first uid-1000 repair attempt after recurrence failed opening root-owned FETCH_HEAD; wrong-owner sample showed root-owned refs/recovery, logs/HEAD, FETCH_HEAD, info/refs; normalizing the whole bare repo to uid 1000 followed by mirror fetch as ec2-user made cat-file and full fsck clean, and the previously failing push succeeded. Prevention change 2829 merged with LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1: committed jgit.config, materializer/compose-up seeding, autodeploy manual-apply signal, and repair runbook. Scratch-equivalent verification: the exact failing operation was exercised by blackfly PS4 and follow-up 2832 push+rebase-submit after repair; both pushed and submitted cleanly, so I did not create an extra throwaway Gerrit change.
